title: Group B: Faculty Members (Deans, HoDs, and VCs)
description: Assessment of academic entrepreneurship, curriculum integration, and institutional alignment.

questions.text: How actively does your faculty or department leadership promote an entrepreneurial culture alongside traditional basic research academic tracks?
Do you believe your university’s current tenure and promotion policies sufficiently reward faculty who actively engage in academic entrepreneurship?
How effectively does your university transfer intellectual property and scientific research to commercial marketplace buyers?
Do you systematically encourage student researchers to test their technological concepts via customer discovery interviews before submitting peer-reviewed papers?
What level of structural support does your university leadership receive from government policy frameworks to operationalize incubation infrastructure?
Do your engineering or business curricula explicitly incorporate Lean Startup methodology concepts like Minimum Viable Product (MVP) design?
How frequently do active industry experts serve on your academic department's steering committees to co-create market-relevant research agendas?
Do you face institutional stress between meeting academic publication targets and delivering commercially viable spinoff metrics for the incubator?
How open is your current executive leadership team to relaxing university equity-share rules to attract private venture capitalist investment?
What is the overall commitment level of top-tier university administration to building an active local Triple Helix innovation ecosystem?
